records.title: Improving Weak World Models Behind Strong Agents in Atari Pong
records.reason: This is world-model and reinforcement-learning research for Atari, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Reverse to Advance: Teleoperation-Cost Effective Hard Policy Learning from Reversed Easy Tasks
records.reason: The paper optimizes robot teleoperation-data collection and policy learning, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Kaleido: Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design for Video Diffusion Transformers by Exploiting Latent Space Correlations
records.reason: Kaleido accelerates video diffusion transformers; despite transformer attention overlap, the workload is vDiT video generation rather than LLM inference/serving.

records.title: CMI-Mem: Toward Generalizable Long-Term Memory Management via CMI-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: CMI-Mem is an LLM-agent memory manager and the abstract claims more efficient training and inference, but the body reports memory QA accuracy and RL rollout/training stability without inference latency, token, or runtime-resource results. The efficiency claim cannot yet be tied to the in-scope serving path.
